lines: God all-going god boundless how Śiva is invoked is forgiven; thus asked spoke Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: devaḥ sarvagato deva nirmaryādaḥ kathaṃ śivaḥ āvāhyate kṣamyate vetyevaṃpṛṣṭo@bravīdvibhuḥ
